scope: Presentation-only edge finish of user-preferred v15. Trim only small convex mesh boundary teeth; entire horizontal faces including their XY contours, interior vertices, strong geometric creases, semantic signs/doors/glazing and stair guards stay fixed. Freezing horizontal contours avoids the newly visible floor cracks in rejected v16. No added faces, hole caps, pose optimization or floor/ceiling level changes. Texture correction is a narrow high-gradient antialiasing band with bounded changes; source semantic photo images and overall v15 material/lighting remain preserved. Acceptance requires actual same-camera rendered visual review.
